dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular, light-toned annular perimeters with jagged edges surrounding dark central regions, primarily distributed along the dorsal and upper lateral surfaces.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, dark, low-intensity pixel clusters concentrated in the ventral-lateral and neck regions, exhibiting irregular shapes without internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest dorsal annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle; a secondary cluster of four smaller annuli on the mid-lateral flank forms a rough quadrilateral.

other_distinctive_markers: Set of long, high-contrast, linear white vibrissae extending from the snout area across the neck, creating sharp geometric intersections with the fur pattern.
